pages.raw: The Seared Furnace can be any size from 3x3 to 11x11, and with any height from a minimum of 3. Larger structures increase the amount of items that can smelt at once. In order to be a valid structure, it requires a floor and ceiling, along

with a frame around the sides (frames around the ceiling and floor are optional) The structure can be made using seared blocks of any kind with a single controller. At least one tank for fuel must be present, placed at an outer edge of the
structure (see picture). The ceiling can be swapped out for slabs or stairs, but otherwise supports the same blocks as the rest of the structure.

The Seared Furnace

The Seared Furnace is a master to all furnaces, cooking quarter stacks at once and cooking food with greater speed.
